title: Beneath the Moon Once Again
content:
For a few long moments...

Neither Siddu nor Sneha moved.

Their eyes remained locked.

Five years of separation...

Five years of silence...

Five years of unanswered questions...

Everything seemed to disappear in that single moment.

Slowly...

Almost unconsciously...

They began walking toward each other.

Step by step...

The distance between them grew smaller.

Neither of them knew what to say.

Neither of them wanted to break the silence.

Sometimes...

The eyes speak far more than words ever can.

Both smiled softly.

A smile filled with relief.

A smile that had waited five long years to bloom.

Just as they were only a few steps away from each other...

A relative hurried toward them.

"Siddu!"

"The bride and groom are ready."

"They're about to go to the stage."

The beautiful moment shattered.

Both of them looked away for a brief second.

A trace of disappointment appeared in their eyes.

Siddu smiled apologetically.

"I..."

Before he could say another word...

Yashwanth called out once again.

Siddu nodded gently and walked toward the wedding stage.

Sneha quietly followed behind.

Siddu took his place beside Yashwanth.

Sneha walked over to stand beside Varsha.

As the wedding rituals began...

Yashwanth quietly leaned toward Siddu.

"Siddu..."

"I have one request."

Siddu looked at him.

"Stay beside me until the wedding is over."

"That's the only help I want from you today."

Siddu smiled warmly.

He understood.

Yashwanth wasn't asking for help.

He simply wanted his best friend beside him during the happiest moment of his life.

Without hesitation...

Siddu nodded.

"I'll be right here."

The sacred rituals continued.

The holy fire burned brightly.

The wedding vows were exchanged.

At the auspicious moment...

Yashwanth tied the sacred mangalsutra around Varsha's neck.

The entire hall echoed with applause and heartfelt blessings.

Watching his best friend begin a new chapter of life...

A peaceful smile appeared on Siddu's face.

For the first time...

He found himself imagining his own future.

A life...

Shared with someone he truly loved.

Before he realized it...

The ceremony had come to an end.

Siddu hugged Yashwanth warmly.

"Congratulations."

Yashwanth laughed happily.

"Thank you."

Then he smiled.

"No..."

"Thank you..."

"For giving me this life."

Siddu gently patted his shoulder.

"I only reminded you to fight for your happiness."

The priest then called the newly married couple.

"Now seek the blessings of your elders."

Yashwanth and Varsha respectfully bowed before their parents and elders, receiving their heartfelt blessings.

Seeing that everything had finally settled...

Siddu quietly stepped away from the crowd.

He slowly walked toward the far end of the wedding venue.

The cheerful sounds of the celebration gradually faded behind him.

Only the gentle rustling of leaves remained.

Trees stood silently beneath strings of warm golden lights.

Above them...

The moon shone brilliantly across the night sky, surrounded by countless twinkling stars.

Siddu lifted his head and gazed at the heavens.

The cool breeze brushed against his face.

Yet...

His heart remained restless.

"Why did seeing Sneha make me feel like this?"

"Have I really moved on?"

"Or have I simply been hiding my feelings all these years?"

Lost in his thoughts...

He didn't notice someone approaching.

Then...

A gentle voice called from behind.

"Siddu..."

The moment he heard that voice...

His heartbeat quickened.

Slowly...

He turned around.

Standing beneath the moonlight...

Wrapped in a graceful blackish-grey saree...

Was Sneha.

The soft breeze gently swayed the loose strands of her hair.

The moonlight reflected in her eyes, making them sparkle with quiet emotion.

For a brief moment...

Siddu forgot how to breathe.

The woman he had spent five years trying to forget...

Was standing only a few steps away.

And at that very moment...

He realized something.

He had never truly forgotten her.

Neither of them spoke.

They simply looked into each other's eyes once again.

Finally...

Sneha broke the silence.

"So..."

"What are you going to do now?"

Siddu smiled faintly.

"I'll return to France."

"And continue my usual routine."

Sneha gently shook her head.

"I wasn't asking about your work."

She looked directly into his eyes.

"I meant your life."

After a brief pause...

She softly asked,

"Are you... in a relationship with someone?"

Siddu quietly shook his head.

"No."

"I'm not."

Sneha lowered her gaze for a moment before looking back into his eyes.

"Then..."

"Who are you planning to marry?"

Siddu remained silent.

He had no answer.

The night around them became unusually still.

Summoning every ounce of courage...

Sneha asked the question that had lived in her heart for years.

"Don't you... love me anymore?"

The question pierced straight through Siddu's heart.

The answer was already on his lips.

He wanted to tell her everything.

He wanted to tell her that not a single day had passed without thinking about her.

But just as the words were about to escape...

A forgotten memory flashed across his mind.

A familiar voice...

A promise he had once made...

A conversation with a middle-aged man.

The memory stopped him.

The words that had almost escaped his heart disappeared once again.

He stood there...

Silent.

And beneath the moonlit sky...

Sneha waited...

For an answer that never came.
